lines: -   List View: Use the theme's brand colors for selected labels, anchor badges and action focus rings. When design tokens are loaded, setting `--wp-admin-theme-color` alone no longer changes the selected row's fill ([#87177](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87177)).
-   Block tools: Ignore keyboard shortcuts and Escape to exit pattern editing during IME composition ([#87355](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87355)).

-   Block hover outline: Stop the outline from flickering when the pointer moves between elements inside a block, such as the buttons and inputs of a placeholder ([#86852](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86852)).

+-   List View, Block Styles: Use `Highlight` and `HighlightText` for the selected row and the active style in forced colors mode, so they follow the active contrast theme in Chromium ([#87010](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87010)).

-   List View: Show every row in view inside panels that change height, and stop Home, End, Page Up and Page Down in other fields from scrolling the list ([#87065](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87065)).
-   List View: Keep focus on a row when it scrolls out of view ([#87065](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87065)).

-   Writing flow: Keep the browser from deleting into a neighbouring block while the canvas is the editing host, which left the canvas out of step with the block list and crashed the editor ([#87188](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87188)).
// Prevent backplate with same color as text in dark mode.
// The action buttons' rings are inset over the selected background.
-   `BoxControl`: Show the side input tooltip above `@wordpress/ui` overlays such as `Dialog` and `Popover` ([#86805](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86805)).
-   `MenuItem`: Show items with `aria-disabled` in the system disabled color in forced colors mode ([#86797](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86797)).

-   `AlignmentMatrixControl`: Show cell tooltips with the `@wordpress/ui` `Tooltip`, so they appear above `@wordpress/ui` overlays such as `Dialog` and `Popover`. Each cell's accessible name is now its translated label, such as "Top Left", instead of its untranslated value, such as "top left" ([#86807](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86807)).

+-   `Button`, `Toolbar`: Use `Highlight` and `HighlightText` for pressed buttons in forced colors mode, so they follow the active contrast theme in Chromium ([#87010](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87010)).
-   `DatePicker`: Outline today's date when another date is selected ([#87172](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87172)).

-   `ComboboxControl`, `FormTokenField`: Let the Escape key close a parent `Modal` or `Popover` when the suggestions list is already closed, and from the `ComboboxControl` Reset button. Stop an Escape key press that closes the suggestions list from also closing a parent `@wordpress/ui` `Dialog` ([#87302](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87302)).

-   `GradientPicker`, `CustomGradientPicker`: Restore the last committed linear angle when switching back from Radial after a background update suspends ([#86739](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86739)).
// The fill stays on the `::before`, which is inset from the button. A
// consumer that hides the `::before` has to fill the button itself, or
-			// `SelectedItemText` ends up on the toolbar's background.
+			// `HighlightText` ends up on the toolbar's background.
// TODO: Add a way to opt out of the toolbar's `::before` treatment, so
// that consumers don't have to undo it and restore the fill themselves.
-   Keep the widget inserter open when Escape is pressed during IME composition ([#87353](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87353)).

+-   Use `Highlight` and `HighlightText` for the pressed header buttons in forced colors mode, so they follow the active contrast theme in Chromium ([#87010](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87010)).
-   Save widget areas in sequence so overlapping requests cannot move widgets to Inactive Widgets ([#87445](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87445)).
-   Sidebar: Make the tab bar 48px tall, like the inserter's, with the selected tab's indicator over its bottom border ([#87333](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87333)).

+-   Use `Highlight` and `HighlightText` for the pressed header buttons in forced colors mode, so they follow the active contrast theme in Chromium ([#87010](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87010)).
-   Notes: Keep note forms open when Escape is pressed during IME composition ([#87352](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87352)).

+-   Document Overview, Notes: Use `Highlight` and `HighlightText` for the pressed header buttons and reactions in forced colors mode, so they follow the active contrast theme in Chromium ([#87010](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87010)).
-   `PageAttributesPanel`: Hide parent controls for non-hierarchical post types ([#85679](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/85679)).
-   Hide the decorative author avatar in the revisions timeline from assistive technologies, as the name of the author is next to it ([#87222](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87222)).

-   `PostTaxonomiesFlatTermSelector`, `PostTaxonomiesHierarchicalTermSelector`: Prevent saving the post while a new term is being created, so the term isn't left out of the saved post ([#87321](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87321)).
// pressed pill needs its own fill.
// A resolved note's pills stay in the disabled `GrayText`.
// Otherwise the emoji sits on a `Canvas` backplate.
-   `Tabs`: Show the selection indicator as a solid line in forced colors mode at every pixel density ([#87347](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87347)).
-   `Tabs`: Show an outline only on the keyboard-focused tab in forced colors mode, not on a hovered tab ([#86913](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/86913)).

-   `Notice.List`: Keep words apart across line breaks and block elements, such as paragraphs and list items, when announcing a notice's title and description ([#87350](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87350)).

--   `CollapsibleCard.Header`: Recommend `role="heading"` and `aria-level` to expose the header as a heading, instead of rendering it as a native `<h1>`–`<h6>` element, which can't contain the `<div>` trigger ([#87460](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87460)).

+-   `Button`, `Combobox`: Use `Highlight` and `HighlightText` for pressed buttons and focused or hovered chips in forced colors mode, so they follow the active contrast theme in Chromium. These chips no longer draw their text on a backplate ([#87010](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87010)).

+-   `Input`, `InputControl`, and the controls built on them: Stop VoiceOver in Chrome on macOS from reading the value of a number input as a percentage of its range. Number inputs now set `aria-valuetext` to their value unless one is passed ([#87115](https://github.com/WordPress/gutenberg/pull/87115)).
